D: A K-pop girl group who secretly hunt demons face a rival boy band with a dark secret.
P: Serve the ramyeon when the girls finally get their noodle break.
S: the snack for a busy schedule
Rice, egg, carrot, spinach, pickled radish and ham rolled in seaweed and sliced into rounds.
Seoul street food after the show
Chewy rice cakes simmered in a sweet and spicy gochujang sauce with fish cake and spring onion.
the street food stall in the city square
Korean hot dogs on a stick: sausage wrapped in mozzarella and a thick batter, fried crisp, rolled in sugar and finished with ketchup and mustard.
M: the noodle break the girls live for
Spicy instant-style noodles upgraded with a soft egg, spring onion, kimchi and a slice of cheese.
the three of them sharing a comfort meal
Milky ox bone soup simmered for hours, seasoned at the table with salt and spring onion, with rice and a spread of banchan like cubed radish kimchi.
W: Yeasted dough filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and nuts, pan-fried until crisp and molten inside.
K: the grape juice pouches relabelled as medicine for Rumi's voice
Cold grape juice poured into little pouches or small bottles and labelled as a vocal tonic, exactly the trick the healer pulls in the film.

s.note: the snack for a busy schedule
s.how: Season 300g cooked sushi rice with sesame oil and salt. Lay rice on 4 nori sheets, add strips of omelette from 2 eggs, sautéed carrot, blanched spinach and pickled radish, then roll tightly and slice into rounds.

s.note: the street food stall in the city square
s.how: Thread 8 frankfurts onto skewers with a stick of mozzarella above each. Whisk 250g self-raising flour, 1 egg, 2 tbsp sugar and 250ml milk into a thick batter, pour into a tall glass, dip each skewer and roll in 100g panko. Fry at 170C for 4 minutes, roll in sugar and drizzle with ketchup and mustard.

m.note: the noodle break the girls live for
m.how: Bring 2L water to the boil with 2 tbsp gochugaru, 2 tbsp soy and a stock cube. Cook 4 packets ramen noodles for 3 minutes, crack in 4 eggs and cover 1 minute. Divide into bowls with 200g kimchi, sliced spring onions and a slice of cheese melting on top.

w.how: Mix 300g flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp sugar and 220ml warm milk into a sticky dough and prove 1 hour. Fill 8 balls with 80g brown sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and 40g chopped walnuts, flatten in an oiled pan and fry 2 minutes a side until crisp.

d.note: the grape juice pouches relabelled as medicine for Rumi's voice
d.how: Chill 1.2L grape juice. Pour into 4 small bottles or pouches, write a label for each that says vocal tonic, and serve very cold. Add a squeeze of lemon and a splash of soda water to each if you want it fizzy.
